secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign auth tokens (any long random string). Falls back to a built-in dev default if unset.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Google Cloud service account email for Google Sheets sync (optional; can also be configured in the app's Settings page).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Private key of the Google service account for Sheets sync (optional).

secrets.name: SPREADSHEET_ID
secrets.description: ID of the Google Sheet used as the remote backup/sync store (optional).
